title: Intrinsically Disordered Regions Define Unique Protein Interaction Networks in CHD Family Remodelers
authors: Mehdi Sharifi Tabar; Chirag Parsania; Caroline Giardina; Yue Feng; Alex CH Wong; Cynthia Metierre; Rajini Nagarajah; Bijay P Dhungel; John EJ Rasko; Charles G Bailey
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合蛋白质组学与AlphaFold Multimer，系统绘制CHD家族染色质重塑因子无序区域介导的PPI网络，并揭示APR区域对NuRD/ChAHP复合物互作及转录调控的关键机制，对象、互作与方法三者齐备且聚焦互作机制建模。
abstract: Chromodomain helicase DNA-binding (CHD1-9) enzymes reposition nucleosomal DNA for transcription, recombination, and replication. They possess highly conserved ATPase domains flanked by poorly characterised N- and C-termini, which are enriched with intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) and short aggregation-prone regions (APRs). The roles of IDRs and APRs in CHD function has remained elusive. Here, by integrating proteomics and AlphaFold Multimer analysis, we defined the protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks within the N- and C-termini of all CHDs. We generated a comprehensive map of CHD1-9-specific binding proteins, revealing dozens of novel interactions with transcription regulators. We identified APR regions that contribute to PPI formation and demonstrated that a highly conserved APR within the C-terminus of CHD4 is critical for its interaction with the nucleosome remodeling and deacetylase (NuRD), as well as the CHD, ADNP, and HP1 (ChAHP) complexes. Further analysis unravels a regulatory role for the CHD4 APR in gene transcription during erythrocyte formation. Our results emphasize that the N- and C-termini of CHD chromatin remodelers establish PPI networks that drive unique transcriptional programs.
abstract_zh: 染色质域解旋酶DNA结合（CHD1-9）酶重新定位核小体DNA，以促进转录、重组和复制。它们具有高度保守的ATP酶结构域，两侧是特征不明确的N端和C端，这些区域富含 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 和短 aggregation-prone regions (APRs)。IDRs和APRs在CHD功能中的作用至今仍不明确。在此，通过整合蛋白质组学和AlphaFold Multimer分析，我们定义了所有CHD的N端和C端内的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。我们生成了CHD1-9特异性结合蛋白的综合图谱，揭示了数十种与转录调控因子的新相互作用。我们识别出有助于PPI形成的APR区域，并证明CHD4 C端内一个高度保守的APR对其与核小体重塑和去乙酰化酶（NuRD）以及CHD、ADNP和HP1（ChAHP）复合物的相互作用至关重要。进一步分析揭示了CHD4 APR在红细胞形成过程中基因转录中的调控作用。我们的结果强调，CHD染色质重塑因子的N端和C端建立了驱动独特转录程序的PPI网络。
